status: frozen before chart generation and model inference
noise_definition: Nested Brownian bridges, maximum absolute perturbation normalized to one clean template price range. Bridges are zero at each defining pivot; all five positive amplitudes reuse the same bridge. Final post-breakout padding is unperturbed.

framing_control.method: Time-axis interpolation of the same OHLCV template and noise realization. This holds bar count constant; it is not a new historical window.

definitions.Head and Shoulders: Three peaks. Middle is highest; shoulders differ by <= 0.03 of template height. Two intervening troughs define a near-horizontal neckline. Final decline crosses below that neckline; terminal padding remains below it.
definitions.Inverse Head and Shoulders: Price inversion of Head and Shoulders. Three troughs, deepest in the middle, similar outer troughs, then a rise above the two-peak neckline.
definitions.Double Top: Two peaks differ by <= 0.03 of template height, separated by a deep trough. Price subsequently crosses below the trough and remains below during terminal padding.
definitions.Double Bottom: Price inversion of Double Top. Two similarly low troughs separated by a high peak, followed by a break above the intervening peak.
definitions.Triangle: Alternating upper and lower pivots converge. Symmetric, ascending and descending constructions share one label. The final segment crosses the converging boundary and stays outside it.
definitions.Bull Flag: A steep rising pole, then a downward-sloping approximately parallel channel with smaller oscillations, followed by an upward break above the flag and pole high.
definitions.None: Monotonic linear or gently curved paths without the reversal or consolidation geometry of the other six whole-window classes. Noisy variants retain this generator label, not a claim that an independent detector must still reject every local pattern.

interpretation: Labels identify the clean source geometry. Noise increases visual ambiguity; no trained or rule-based detector is used to relabel variants. This balanced artificial set is a visual recognition sanity test, not market prevalence or forecast evidence.
mirror: Horizontal flipping reverses time; it does not exchange Head and Shoulders with Inverse, or Double Top with Double Bottom. Only vertical price inversion creates those counterparts.
